dct_description_sm: There are a number of Community Facilities within the City offering a wide range of uses, and this designation is intended for a variety of public and private institutional-type uses. Examples within this designation include municipal facilities and buildings, educational facilities, religious assemblies, clubs, cemeteries, community care facilities, health services, emergency services, airport, correctional services, transportation depot, and library & exhibits
